name: AWS CodeDeploy
tagline_ar: خدمة نشر تُنسّق تحديث الكود على EC2/On-Prem/Lambda/ECS باستراتيجيات Canary/Linear/AllAtOnce مع hooks عبر appspec.yml.
tagline_en: Deployment service orchestrating updates to EC2/On-Prem/Lambda/ECS with Canary/Linear/AllAtOnce strategies and appspec.yml hooks.

key_concepts.desc_ar: وحدة منطقية تحوي deployment groups؛ نوعها EC2/OnPrem, Lambda, أو ECS.
key_concepts.desc_en: Logical unit containing deployment groups; compute platform EC2/OnPrem, Lambda, or ECS.

key_concepts.desc_ar: مجموعة أهداف النشر (EC2 tags/ASG/Lambda function/ECS service).
key_concepts.desc_en: Set of targets (EC2 tags/ASG/Lambda function/ECS service).

key_concepts.desc_ar: يحدّد files/permissions وhooks: ApplicationStop, BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, ApplicationStart, ValidateService.
key_concepts.desc_en: Defines files/permissions and hooks: ApplicationStop, BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, ApplicationStart, ValidateService.

key_concepts.desc_ar: يحدّد function versions وhooks: BeforeAllowTraffic, AfterAllowTraffic.
key_concepts.desc_en: Defines function versions and hooks: BeforeAllowTraffic, AfterAllowTraffic.

key_concepts.desc_ar: يحدّد TaskDefinition/ContainerName وhooks: BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, AfterAllowTestTraffic, BeforeAllowTraffic, AfterAllowTraffic.
key_concepts.desc_en: Defines TaskDefinition/ContainerName with hooks: BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, AfterAllowTestTraffic, BeforeAllowTraffic, AfterAllowTraffic.

key_concepts.desc_ar: AllAtOnce / HalfAtATime / OneAtATime أو مخصص (min healthy hosts).
key_concepts.desc_en: AllAtOnce / HalfAtATime / OneAtATime or custom (min healthy hosts).

key_concepts.desc_ar: Canary / Linear / AllAtOnce مع أمثلة Canary10Percent5Minutes و Linear10PercentEvery1Minute.
key_concepts.desc_en: Canary / Linear / AllAtOnce with presets like Canary10Percent5Minutes, Linear10PercentEvery1Minute.

key_concepts.desc_ar: طريقة نشر تبني بيئة جديدة وتحوّل الحركة إليها (ممكن لـ EC2/Lambda/ECS).
key_concepts.desc_en: Deployment type provisioning new environment and shifting traffic (EC2/Lambda/ECS).

key_concepts.desc_ar: خدمة تعمل على EC2/On-Prem لتلقّي تعليمات النشر.
key_concepts.desc_en: Daemon running on EC2/On-Prem to receive deployment instructions.

cli_commands.cmd: aws deploy create-deployment-group --application-name my-app --deployment-group-name prod --service-role-arn arn:... --deployment-config-name CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes

when_to_use.scenario_ar: نشر ملاحي آمن لـ Lambda بعد Canary
when_to_use.scenario_en: Safe Lambda traffic shift via Canary

when_to_use.scenario_ar: نشر بلا خدمة موقوفة على ECS خلف ALB
حفظ النسخة العاملة في حال الفشل
نشر تدريجي نصف الخوادم كل مرة
when_to_use.scenario_en: Gradual rollout half of fleet at a time

exam_tips.ar: Lambda deployments تستخدم Canary/Linear/AllAtOnce؛ EC2 تستخدم AllAtOnce/HalfAtATime/OneAtATime.
exam_tips.en: Lambda uses Canary/Linear/AllAtOnce; EC2 uses AllAtOnce/HalfAtATime/OneAtATime.

exam_tips.ar: Canary10Percent5Minutes يعني 10% أولاً، ثم 90% بعد 5 دقائق.
ECS Blue/Green يتطلب ALB/NLB مع target groups اثنين (blue/green).
exam_tips.en: ECS Blue/Green requires ALB/NLB with two target groups (blue/green).

exam_tips.ar: Auto rollback يبدأ عند deployment failure أو تفعيل CloudWatch alarm محدد.
exam_tips.en: Auto rollback triggers on deployment failure or specified CloudWatch alarm.
